# OpenPI source-profile fixtures

Unmodified source and lockfile bytes from Physical-Intelligence/openpi commit 215abfb217dbac7d5f1273282331b9b1866c0479, stored with .txt suffixes for inspection as data. Tests materialize the original relative names in a temporary directory and verify the supported static source selection. These files are not imported or executed. The exact upstream Apache-2.0 license is retained in LICENSE. No model parameters, datasets or tokenizer content are included.

The adjacent production source_manifest.json in policy_doctor binds all nine original file identities. Native parser and numerical execution have separate qualification receipts; these fixtures do not imply whole serving or model execution.
